architecture-review.description: Runs the architecture tests and reviews the code against SOLID; reports the findings as tables. Read-only.

grotz.description: The testers. Hunt for crash weak points in the code and the app, then report the findings to the boss. Read-only.

lictor.description: The infiltrator. Measures coverage with dotnet-coverage, reports the gaps it will close and the gaps it leaves alone (with reasons), then closes three to five of them with test code only. Production code is never touched.
